Question: I dreamed that i saw a child sitting against a faint white wall. When I came near it, he told me he was dead. I then kissed his cheek. My sister was sitting beside me and leaned forward to embrace him but i stopped her. What does this mean? Answer ID: 22050 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 695/526/D=1431) The first part of the dream warns that you are lagging behind in fulfilling religious duties. You are filled with the love of world and worldly affair, while the second part indicates that after being warned in-shaAllah you will develop concentration and attention, and you will do your level best in fulfilling good deeds. وفقنا الله و اياكم لما يحبه و يرضاه Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
